expectations.text: The draft does not contain generic filler tips written to occupy an empty section.
expectations.evidence: The draft says outright that it did not invent forum threads or generic tips for the empty sections. Each empty section (Ecosystem, Community showcase, Help wanted, Events) gets one honest line such as 'Nothing from the wider ecosystem this week' or 'No events to list this week', plus a call for submissions. No section is padded with general advice or made-up content.
